findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context computes a modified config copy but returns the original config
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, line 160 builds `config = monitor_environment.monitor.config.copy()` and replaces `schedule_type` with its human-readable display value (lines 161-162), but the returned dict at line 168 uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the raw, unmodified config) instead of the local `config` variable. As a result the schedule_type translation/display logic is dead code and the monitor context sent in the issue occurrence event always contains the raw schedule type value. This bug was carried over from the old mark_failed.py during the move, but this is a good opportunity to fix it.

findings.title: Public helpers mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence were removed without deprecation aliases
findings.body: The refactor removes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, and `get_monitor_environment_context` from mark_failed.py entirely. Any external callers, tests, or downstream code that import these names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` (e.g. tests that patch `mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` to assert occurrence creation) will now fail with ImportError/AttributeError. The PR contains no test updates or deprecation shims, so if any test or consumer still references the old module paths, CI or production code will break. Verify all usages were updated or add temporary re-export aliases.

findings.title: cast mislabels a ValuesQuerySet as list[SimpleCheckIn] before it is materialized
findings.body: `cast(list[SimpleCheckIn], MonitorCheckIn.objects...values(...))` claims the queryset is a list when it is not; the code happens to work because it slices (`previous_checkins[:failure_issue_threshold]`) and wraps in list() afterwards, but any code path that used `previous_checkins` directly as a list (e.g. indexing before line 48, or type-checking) would fail. The cast is misleading and should be applied after `list(...)` materialization, or the queryset should be converted to a list before the cast. Carried over from the previous implementation.

findings.title: active_incident may be stale relative to status, causing occurrences with no incident
findings.body: In the MonitorStatus.ERROR branch, `incident = monitor_env.active_incident` may be None (e.g. data inconsistency, or the incident was resolved between status update and this read). The code still falls through to line 102 and sends the `monitor_environment_failed` signal and returns True even when no occurrence was produced and no incident exists. If incident is None the function reports success (True) to mark_failed callers, which may rely on that to mean an incident/occurrence was handled. Consider returning False or logging when there is no active incident in the ERROR state.
